title: jasminum diversifolium
intro: Jasminum diversifolium, commonly known as the variable jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. The variable jasmine has been traditionally used in various cultures for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as an anti-inflammatory and antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of the variable jasmine are attributed to its ability to induce relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of the variable jasmine include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
